meta.description: Use cases with editorial ranked toolIds and why strings.

useCases.title: Best research tools
useCases.summary: Web search and deep research for builders and agents.
useCases.audience: Builders researching markets, docs, and competitors — plus agents that need reliable search.

editorial.why: Best default for fast, cited answers without leaving the browser.
Neural search that returns pages agents can actually use.
Drop-in search API when your agent needs structured results.

useCases.title: Best AI coding editors
useCases.summary: Editors where vibe coding actually ships.
useCases.audience: Vibe coders and solo builders who live in the editor.

editorial.why: Still the sweet spot for AI-native editing and multi-file changes.
Cascade agent feels like a teammate inside a full IDE.
Blazing fast when you want AI without the bloat.

useCases.title: Best coding agents
useCases.summary: Agents that write, test, and iterate on code for you.
useCases.audience: Builders who want agents to take a ticket from prompt to PR.

editorial.why: Strongest terminal agent for real repos and long sessions.
Open, model-agnostic, and great for git-aware pair coding.
Closest to autonomous end-to-end engineering — when budget allows.

useCases.title: Best AI video tools
useCases.summary: Text-to-video and editing tools for demos and content.
useCases.audience: Builders shipping product demos, launch videos, and social clips.

editorial.why: Most polished creator workflow from prompt to edit.
Strong motion and longer clips for cinematic demos.
Fast iterations when you need volume over perfection.

useCases.title: Best MCP servers / agent tooling
useCases.summary: Connect agents to tools, browsers, and APIs.
useCases.audience: Agent builders wiring real-world actions into their stack.

editorial.why: The open standard — start here before picking vendors.
Hundreds of managed integrations so you skip OAuth hell.
Reliable headless browsers when agents need to click the web.

useCases.title: Best AI writing for builders
useCases.summary: Writing tools that help ship docs, threads, and product copy.
useCases.audience: Builders who need clear writing without a content team.

editorial.why: Best when your docs already live in Notion.
Purpose-built for shipping builder threads on X.
Quick polish for READMEs, emails, and landing pages.
